scripts.build: rimraf dist && yarn workspace proto build && yarn workspace weather build && yarn workspace notifications build && yarn workspace subscription build && yarn workspace gateway build
scripts.build:test: rimraf dist && yarn workspace weather build:test && yarn workspace subscription build:test
scripts.start:dev: concurrently -n gateway,notifications,weather,subscription -c yellow,green,cyan,magenta "yarn workspace gateway start:dev" "yarn workspace notifications start:dev" "yarn workspace weather start:dev" "yarn workspace subscription start:dev"
scripts.start:prod: concurrently -n gateway,notifications,weather,subscription -c yellow,green,cyan,magenta "yarn workspace gateway start:prod" "yarn workspace notifications start:prod" "yarn workspace weather start:prod" "yarn workspace subscription start:prod"
scripts.start:test: concurrently -n gateway,notifications,weather,subscription -c yellow,green,cyan,magenta "yarn workspace gateway start:test" "yarn workspace notifications start:test" "yarn workspace weather start:test" "yarn workspace subscription start:test"
scripts.docker:integration: yarn workspace subscription docker:integration && yarn workspace weather docker:integration
